label: original-phase input of l / 3 / z / k / q (context-gated)
explanation: Fires mainly during the original phase (79% of mass), peaking at t=2-4, when the input is one of a small set of tokens: l (rate 35%, 24% of mass, and nearly all top activations), then 3, z, k, q. It also fires weakly on the <DEL> step (15% of mass) and rarely in the copy phase. Repeated occurrences of a token fire much less than first occurrences. Whether it fires on a trigger token depends strongly on earlier context: top examples come after prefixes of g/t/r/s/y/x/n/u, and the same trigger tokens often stay silent after other prefixes. Prefix-set predicates did not capture this gating cleanly. The token predicate reaches F1 about 0.39 and mass recall about 0.60 on dev; precision is low (0.31) because of that context dependence, and about 40% of mass falls on other tokens (DEL, b, 2, c, o, 1 and others).
